exam: APPSC Forest Beat Officer & Assistant Beat Officer Screening
q: The main constituents of Bio-gas or Gobar gas are
explanation: Biogas is mainly methane (50-65%) with carbon dioxide (35-50%) and traces of hydrogen, nitrogen and hydrogen sulphide, so 'all of the above' is the intended answer; methane alone is only the main constituent.

exam: APPSC Junior Assistant cum Typist in Prisons & Correctional
q: Which is the major constituent of Gobar Gas?
explanation: Gobar gas (biogas) is mainly methane (50-65%), with CO2 next; ethane, butane and H2S are not the major constituent.

exam: APPSC Forest Beat Officer & Assistant Beat Officer (Mains) P
q: The wastes discharged from a biogas plant are reused as
explanation: The slurry (digestate) left after biogas is made is a nutrient-rich organic manure, so it is reused as fertilizer for crops. It is not used as cooking fuel (the gas is), animal feed or building material.

exam: APPSC Forest Section Officer Screening Test General Studies
q: Leading ethanol producing country
explanation: The USA is the world's leading ethanol producer (mainly corn ethanol), ahead of Brazil (sugarcane). India is third.

notes.text: - **Composting** is **aerobic** decomposition, unlike biogas.
